name: sp500-drawdowns-vs-bonds-drawdowns
description: Compares drawdowns of bonds (AGG) vs stocks (SPY), showing bonds have historically smaller drawdowns.
source:
# Bond vs Stock Historical Drawdowns
src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# SPY drawdown
spy_max = agg(close, AggregationType.Max)
spy_dd = (close - spy_max) / spy_max

# AGG via reference
bonds = reference_assets(stock("AGG"))
agg_o = bonds.o
agg_h = bonds.h
agg_l = bonds.l
agg_c = bonds.c
agg_v = bonds.v
agg_vw = bonds.vw
agg_n = bonds.n
bonds_data = ffill(agg_c)
agg_max = agg(bonds_data, AggregationType.Max)
agg_dd = (bonds_data - agg_max) / agg_max

bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Bond vs Stock Historical Drawdowns',
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    area=False,
    y_axis_label='Maximum Drawdown (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Bonds (Bloomberg Agg)', color=Color.Sky),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Stocks (S&P 500)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(bar_ts, agg_dd, spy_dd)
